_description: Machine-readable map of DB tables/columns affected by the mobile 'send order' API. See mobile_order_api_data_map.md for narrative notes.

source.host: localhost:5432 (per app/database.py default; overridable via DATABASE_URL)

endpoints.note: all three get-*-orders endpoints read opmob, NOT opord/opodt

filters.xstatusord: Not enough stock to create Order

endpoints.note: xdatepay is the 'promised payment date'; xdatedel is write-only from this API (never read back by any GET here)
return registration; tax/discount/commission/cost columns on opcdt are always zeroed
POST verb but pure report; filters glheader.xvoucher LIKE 'RCT-%'; this is the accounting-confirmed receipt ledger, distinct from glpmt
reconstructs running customer ledger from GL vouchers (RCT-/JV--/CRCT/STJV/BRCT = payments, INOP = orders)

opmob.role: primary write target; one row per order line item

columns.name: invoicesl
columns.source: random 12-digit number, shared across items in one order

columns.name: xcus
columns.note: not validated against a customer master

columns.name: xitem
columns.note: not validated against an item master

columns.name: xstatusord
columns.note: other statuses set by an out-of-band process

columns.name: xordernum
columns.note: left NULL; populated later by a downstream/legacy process

columns.name: xlinetotal
columns.note: DB column is integer; API/schema treat it as float -> decimals truncated on insert

columns.name: xappver
columns.note: exists in DB, absent from the SQLAlchemy model entirely

location_records.role: optional GPS side-effect of an order; at most one row per order (first valid coordinate found among items)
location_records.write_condition: at least one item has a valid, non-(0,0) xlat/xlong

apiUsers.role: auth lookup for the requesting user and permission check

logged.role: session validation; also updated on every request via global middleware

token_blacklist.note: cleanup_expired_tokens() runs a DELETE on every check call

opdor.role: delivery order header; source of the 'promised payment date'

columns_written.name: xdatedel
columns_written.note: promised/rescheduled delivery date; write-only from this API, never selected back by any GET

columns_written.name: xdatepay
columns_written.note: promised payment date; also not returned by list/detail GETs, only settable

columns_unused_by_api: and the rest of ~55 total columns on the live table

opcrn.note: xtotamt is never persisted on the header despite being computed in the response

opcdt.note: tax/discount/commission/cost are always zero on API-created rows; do not use for return-economics analysis

glpmt.note: xpaydate here is the actual collection date logged by the rep, NOT the promised date (that's opdor.xdatepay). Locally only 9 rows exist, all still xpaystatus='Send' (none confirmed 'Received').

glheader.role: GL voucher header; read-only source for customer receipts report and customer balance ledger
glheader.note: RCT-prefixed vouchers (118,402 rows locally) are the accounting-confirmed receipt ledger -- ~13,000x more rows than glpmt, confirming these are posted by a separate back-office process, not this API

gldetail.role: GL voucher line items; joined to glheader for the same read-only reports

not_written_by_this_api.opord: read-only via GET /api/v1/customers/customer-by-id/{zid}/{customer_id} (sales_return_db_controller.py, for yearly/monthly gross-sales totals); a THIRD distinct order table from opmob and opdor/opddt; populated by an out-of-band/legacy process
not_written_by_this_api.imtemptrn: damage return header; CORRECTED from an earlier version of this doc which wrongly called this dead code -- it IS read, by the same customer-by-id endpoint, to sum damage-return amounts (voucher patterns %RECA%/%SRE-%/%RECT-%/%DSR-%)
not_written_by_this_api.imtemptdt: damage return detail; same as imtemptrn

clarifications.confirmed_orders_source: get-confirmed/pending/cancelled-orders all read opmob filtered by xstatusord, NOT opord/opodt. An earlier version of this doc incorrectly pointed to opord/opodt.
clarifications.promised_payment_date: opdor.xdatepay, set via PUT /api/v1/order/delivery-date-update/{zid}/{xdornum}. Distinct from glpmt.xpaydate (actual collection date).
clarifications.return_registration: POST /api/v1/return/create-return, writing opcrn (header) + opcdt (one row per item).
clarifications.collection_registry: Two different things: glpmt (mobile submission log, writable) vs glheader/gldetail RCT- vouchers (accounting-confirmed ledger, read-only in this API).
